text:
Phase 1 (`requirements_analysis`) is complete. The delta requirements specification has been written to `.sdlc/runs/20261106-152732-feature-extend-lasso-box-selection-mode/requirements.md` covering:

- **In scope**: Mode-aware lasso selection geometry in `packages/excalidraw/lasso/utils.ts`, app-state wiring in `packages/excalidraw/lasso/index.ts`, unit/integration test coverage in `packages/excalidraw/tests/lasso.test.tsx` and `packages/excalidraw/tests/selection.test.tsx`, `packages/excalidraw/CHANGELOG.md` entry under `## Unreleased`, and `.sdlc/` in `.gitignore`.
- **Out of scope**: Box-selection code path (`packages/element/src/selection.ts`, `packages/element/src/bounds.ts`, `App.tsx`), UI/menu/locale/appState definitions, `excalidraw-app/**`, and all off-limits paths.
- **Functional & Non-functional requirements**: `FR-1` through `FR-10` and `NFR-1` through `NFR-3` covering `"contain"` (full enclosure without outline intersection) and `"overlap"` (intersection or partial enclosure) across all shape types and bound text, with no per-frame performance regression and full TypeScript safety.
- **PII inventory & Role matrix**: Documented as none / client-side editor only.
- **Acceptance criteria & Open questions**: `AC-1` through `AC-6` with executable test commands (`yarn test:app --watch=false packages/excalidraw/tests/lasso.test.tsx packages/excalidraw/tests/selection.test.tsx`, `yarn test:typecheck`, `yarn test:code`), and no open HITL questions.
